findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: process_json, upload_json, get_upload · Private data: process_json, upload_json, delete_upload, get_upload, get_quota, purchase_access · Public sink: process_json, upload_json, delete_upload, get_upload, get_quota, purchase_access · Destructive: process_json, upload_json, delete_upload, get_upload, get_quota.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: process_json, upload_json, get_upload · Private data: process_json, upload_json, delete_upload, get_upload, get_quota, purchase_access · Public sink: process_json, upload_json, delete_upload, get_upload, get_quota, purchase_access · Destructive: process_json, upload_json, delete_upload, get_upload, get_quota

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
